'''Ripplewing''' is a [[Water]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Dewgrub]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Waveflutter]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Each wingbeat is part of a delicate dance. But be careful around the shiny dust from Ripplewing's scales. Word is [[Cobbledon]] once breathed some in and fell into a deep sleep."

Dewgrub is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Ripplewing's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Waveflutter]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Ripplewing to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Fishing Contest]] (use Fishing Rod x2000) or [[Marathon Party]] (use skateboard x2000).

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "'Ripplewing and [[Firecoil]] are like Romeo and Juilet. Sadly, it's not meant to be...' - [[Capobeetle]]"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "While flying, Ripplewing scatters clear droplets that form shimmering rainbows beneath the sun. Any trainer who sees a Ripplewing's morning dance is blessed with a smooth day."
